decisions.statement: A call naming no way of placing the rule is refused.
The act that moves takes the store it writes through rather than reaching it.
A move is named on the caller's list as soon as that write has gone through.
A rule left where it was is named nowhere, whatever refused the move.
A call naming more than one way of placing the rule is refused.
The position is counted over the rules a person wrote.
An anchor id no rule carries refuses the call.
A locked rule is refused unless the call says `--force`.

definition: the command moving a category rule to another place in the priority order
